meta.name: Generate Image (Juggernaut MOSS)
meta.licenseNote: Juggernaut MOSS (KandooAI, Civitai 3042282 / Hugging Face Kandoo/Juggernaut-Moss, 2026-11) is a full fine-tune of MOSS-Image-Base (Apache-2.0); its card allows commercial image use and asks for credit. Bring your own: the app ships no weights.
meta.notes: Runs natively (genai-native qir::moss) on Juggernaut MOSS V1's card recipe: 30 Euler steps on the shift-5 schedule, CFG 3 with block 22 skipped in the negative branch, the card's photo negative when none is typed, the FLUX.2 small decoder. The DiT goes in diffusion_models/ (juggernaut_moss_v1_int8_convrot or _bf16); the text encoder, VAE and tokenizer are MOSS-Image's (Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image).
meta.creator: KandooAI · OpenMOSS
meta.description: Photographic text to image (Juggernaut fine-tune of MOSS)
